input_output.title: Input and output
input_output.description: Sample sheet, reference, and where results are published.

sample_sheet.help_text: Requires 'sample' and 'fastq1' columns; 'fastq2' is required unless the run is interleaved. Optional columns 'replicate_id', 'primer_id', 'interleaved' and 'read_deduplication' override the corresponding params per row. Relative FASTQ paths resolve against this file's own directory.

reference_fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA. May hold one record per segment.
reference_fasta.help_text: Record IDs are the segment names, and must match the GFF3 seqids, the primer BED chrom column, and each other exactly. The aligned BAM is split by reference name, so a mismatch silently misroutes annotation, primer trimming and the coordinate lift.

reference_gff.description: Reference annotation GFF3, transferred onto each consensus by Nextclade.
reference_gff.help_text: Seqids must match the reference FASTA record IDs.

primers.title: Primers
primers.description: Primer BED lookup and clipping behaviour.

primer_csv.description: CSV mapping each primer_id to its BED file.
primer_csv.help_text: Requires 'primer_id' and 'primer_bedfile' columns. Relative BED paths resolve against this file's own directory. A row with an empty primer_bedfile means 'no primers' (implying that inputs have already had primer sequences trimmed).

primer_id_default.description: primer_id to use for sample-sheet rows that do not set one.
primer_id_default.help_text: Must match a primer_id in primer_csv, case included; a value with no matching row drops those samples from the run. Intended as a convenience that handles common primer schemes.

remove_unclipped_reads.description: Discard reads that samtools ampliconclip did not clip.

skip_fastqc.description: Skip FastQC while still running fastp.

fastp_min_length.description: Discard reads shorter than this after trimming (fastp --length_required).

interleaved.description: Treat fastq1 as an interleaved pair when the sample sheet has no 'interleaved' column.

read_deduplication.description: Deduplication strategy for sample-sheet rows that do not set one.
read_deduplication.help_text: 'amplicon' does not deduplicate at all — it clips primers with samtools ampliconclip instead, and is the only value that reads primer_bedfile. 'umi' is UMI-aware samtools markdup --barcode-name, for MIPs and other tagged libraries. 'positional' is coordinate-based samtools markdup, for hybrid-capture and other untagged libraries. Renamed from sequencing_technique in v2.3.0-Beta along with its values; an old name is a hard error, not a silent fallback.

consensus.title: Consensus calling
consensus.description: Thresholds for mpileup / ivar consensus and the coverage filter.

consensus_min_qual_score.description: ivar consensus -q: minimum base quality to count a base.
consensus_min_qual_score.help_text: Distinct from consensus_min_baseQ, which affects samtools mpileup that generates ivar consensus input.

consensus_threshold.description: ivar consensus -t: allele frequency needed to call a base.

consensus_min_depth.description: ivar consensus -m: minimum depth to call a base rather than N.

consensus_coverage_cutoff.description: Minimum fraction of non-N bases for a consensus to continue to variant calling. Applied per segment, so one poorly covered segment drops only itself.

consensus_min_baseQ.description: samtools mpileup -Q (base quality) for the consensus pileup.

consensus_min_mapQ.description: samtools mpileup -q (map quality) for the consensus pileup.

variant_freq_threshold.description: ivar variants -t: minimum allele frequency to report a variant.

variant_min_depth.description: ivar variants -m: minimum depth to report a variant.

variant_minQ.description: ivar variants -q: minimum base quality to count a base.
variant_minQ.help_text: Distinct from variant_min_baseQ, which affects samtools mpileup that generates ivar variants input.

variant_min_baseQ.description: samtools mpileup -Q (base quality) for the variant pileup.
variant_min_baseQ.help_text: Applies to the published replicate_coverage/ depths as well.

variant_min_mapQ.description: samtools mpileup -q (map quality) for the variant pileup.
variant_min_mapQ.help_text: Applies to the published replicate_coverage/ depths as well.

container_image.help_text: Override this rather than -process.container, which the profiles' withName selector outranks. Ignored unless a container profile (docker, apptainer, test, ...) is active.
